summary: Count to 20 and beyond, count objects one by one to say how many, see up to 4 at a glance and compare groups.
Add by joining groups and take away by separating them, up to 10, using fingers or objects; share fairly.
Sort things by one or two features, and copy, continue and make simple repeating patterns.
Compare and measure things by length, height or weight, and line up 3 to 5 things from smallest to biggest.
Name flat and solid shapes in any size or turn, put shapes together, and use words like inside and beside.
